rooms.name: Reception
rooms.description: A cramped desk near the entrance with an overflowing whiteboard task board
rooms.unlock_text: You arrive at QuickBite HQ. Three founders are already yelling.

rooms.name: Marco's Kitchen Lab
rooms.description: A test kitchen that doubles as an office, grease-stained recipe binders everywhere
rooms.unlock_text: You push through the kitchen door into Marco's domain.

rooms.name: Diana's Corner Office
rooms.description: Dual monitors showing spreadsheets, whiteboards covered in numbers with red circles
rooms.unlock_text: Diana waves you in without looking up from her screens.

rooms.name: Raj's Server Closet
rooms.description: A standing desk crammed between two server racks with monitors in various states of green and red
rooms.unlock_text: You squeeze into the server closet. Raj apologizes for the cables.

rooms.name: Break Room
rooms.description: A kitchenette with a bulletin board overflowing with notes, business cards, and competitor menus
rooms.unlock_text: You have data from all three founders. Time to piece it together.

rooms.name: Chocolot
rooms.description: A sleek, dimly-lit chocolate dessert bar with mood lighting and a suspicious barista
rooms.unlock_text: Research Briefing in hand, you head to the first competitor.

rooms.name: Panini Gemelli
rooms.description: A bright Italian fast-casual spot with checkered tablecloths and twin owners
rooms.unlock_text: The Gemelli brothers' shop. One twin waves. The other glares.

rooms.name: Tabouleh Express
rooms.description: The loading dock behind a Mediterranean restaurant at 6 AM, delivery vans idling
rooms.unlock_text: The delivery dock is buzzing. Time to buy some intel.

rooms.name: The Cooker
rooms.description: A trendy gastropub with a live social wall cycling through customer posts and reviews
rooms.unlock_text: The Cooker's social wall flickers. Posts are disappearing in real-time.

rooms.name: War Room
rooms.description: A glass-walled conference room with a speakerphone already ringing
rooms.unlock_text: Diana needs you. The investor call is happening NOW.

rooms.name: Store #10
rooms.description: An empty restaurant with bare concrete floors and wires hanging from the ceiling
rooms.unlock_text: Investment secured. Now automate the store opening before morning.
